label: FLUX.3 Image Klein Base T2I
prompt: Photorealistic digital illustration of a futuristic cyberpunk city at night, viewed from street level along a broad avenue after heavy rain. The wet black asphalt fills the foreground, reflecting long bands of cyan, magenta, violet, and acid-red neon light in broken ripples around shallow puddles. A narrow stream of runoff crosses the bottom edge beside a grated drain clogged with scraps of paper and metallic debris. In the center, a low autonomous taxi with a dark glass canopy drives toward the viewer, its angular body edged by red warning lights and illuminated by blue underbody strips. Water sprays behind its wheels, while two smaller vehicles recede into the distance as elongated silhouettes with glowing tail lamps. On both sides, dense towers rise beyond stacked balconies, exposed pipes, ventilation ducts, suspended cables, and crowded storefronts. Vertical neon signs project over the sidewalks: a cyan sign on the left reads "NIGHT MARKET", a magenta sign above it reads "SYNTHETIC DISTRICT", and a red sign on the right reads "OPEN 24 HOURS". Smaller panels display abstract symbols and illegible fine print. Elevated pedestrian bridges cross between buildings overhead, carrying clusters of dark human silhouettes beneath transparent umbrellas. Near the left curb, a compact food stall glows turquoise under a striped awning, with steam rising from a metal vent and catching pink light. On the right, a lone figure in a long black hooded coat stands beneath a transparent umbrella, facing the traffic; the coat’s reflective seams trace electric-blue highlights across the shoulders. Tall holographic advertisements float above the intersection, including a rotating wireframe face surrounded by pulsing geometric graphics. In the background, skyscrapers merge into a dark canyon of illuminated windows, rooftop antennas, and luminous skybridges. Low clouds obscure the upper towers, while mist and rain scatter the neon into colored halos around the highest signs.
notes: Replaces flux1_dev_t2i_1024 and flux2_dev_t2i_1024 (retired 2026-10-15); their published results stay in the reports. Base checkpoint, not the step-distilled black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein: a distilled, reduced-step model is a lossy substitute under this repo's policy. 50 steps and CFG 3.5 are the Base settings sglang's FLUX.3 cookbook validated at 1024x1024 (sglang#44418); the seed is the retired FLUX rows'. The prompt is the retired rows' short request ("A futuristic cyberpunk city at night, neon lights reflecting on wet streets") expanded once by BFL's prompt upsampler, because the model card says FLUX.3 is not meant to run on a short prompt: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-pup rev 3f3edb52, served by sglang with --enable-deterministic-inference --disable-radix-cache through the flux3-klein-pup enhancer protocol (sglang PR, 2026-10-16), caption md5 b0e44fd9c061; reruns reproduce it exactly. The caption is frozen here so every framework encodes the same 303 words; the upsampler itself is not timed. The repo is gated (auto-approved request plus the flux-kommunity-license); the account whose HF_TOKEN the run uses must have accepted it. ComfyUI serves it on master (official v0.41 templates); vLLM-Omni and TensorRT-LLM have open PRs (2026-10-16). Measured on 2xH200 2026-10-16 with this caption: sglang 4.035 s, ComfyUI 5.364 s (vLLM-Omni pre-merge 4.534 s); other hardware VALIDATION PENDING.

default.description: CFG parallelism on two GPUs: each GPU runs one CFG branch of the Base model.
default.notes: The Base model runs CFG 3.5, two DiT branches per step, and this repo measured CFG parallelism as the multi-GPU latency path for two-branch models (Qwen-Image true-CFG: 6.49 s against 11.14 s for TP). The cookbook lists TP, Ulysses and CFG parallelism for this pipeline and measured one GPU only (H200 BF16 T2I 7.09 s, GB300 3.21 s, eager, FlashAttention). Eager, as the cookbook recommends (breakable CUDA graphs showed no clear win on GB300). Measured fastest on H200 (see h200-2gpu-cfg-parallel); other hardware VALIDATION PENDING.

h200-2gpu-cfg-parallel.description: H200: CFG parallelism on two GPUs, the fastest measured layout.
h200-2gpu-cfg-parallel.notes: 2026-10-16, 2xH200 (h200-sci), sglang main c15edf314d, torch 2.14.1+cu130, transformers 5.19.0, checkpoint f66af34f9c15, scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh 3 interleaved rounds x 5 requests: CFG parallel 3.637/3.633/3.634 s, TP2 4.018/4.027/4.036 s, Ulysses-2 4.428/4.441/4.431 s (every CFG-parallel sample below every TP2 and Ulysses-2 sample; spreads 0.3-1.1%). FA attention selected by default; text encoder resident under --performance-mode speed (the auto policy layerwise-offloads it even with 139 GiB free).

tp2-candidate.description: TP2 alternative for the tuning A/B. Never selected: no hardware tag.
tp2-candidate.notes: Kept so scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh can interleave it against the CFG-parallel default. TP times Ulysses must divide the 24 attention heads (cookbook). CFG parallelism is turned off explicitly: sglang auto-enables it on two or more GPUs when no sequence-parallel flag is set. 2xH200 2026-10-16: 4.018/4.027/4.036 s, 11% slower than CFG parallel.

ulysses2-candidate.description: Ulysses-2 alternative for the tuning A/B. Never selected: no hardware tag.
ulysses2-candidate.notes: Kept for the tuning A/B, as for tp2-candidate. 2xH200 2026-10-16: 4.428/4.441/4.431 s, 22% slower than CFG parallel.

vllm-omni.reason: No FLUX.3 pipeline on vLLM-Omni main (2026-10-16). It is in the open, approved PR vllm-project/vllm-omni#9007; reclassify once it merges. Measured pre-merge on 2xH200 2026-10-16 at head 389a02a149ce with vllm==0.31.0 (the head's docker/Dockerfile.ci): CFG parallel 2 4.534 s, one GPU 9.101 s (regional compile, FLASH_ATTN). Its FLUX.3 loader reads only a local package directory (model_path = the snapshot dir), and requests need --served-model-name set to the case model.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the official FLUX.3 Klein Base text-to-image template with full-precision weights; CFG branches split over the case's two GPUs.

upstream_recipe.section: Text to Image (FLUX 3 Image Klein) subgraph
upstream_recipe.recheck: Re-checked 2026-10-22: the template's default steps went 25 -> 50 (the case sets steps), model files were renamed with hyphens, and an optional Flux3LayoutPrompt node was added; sampler, scheduler and graph are unchanged.

default.notes: Official image_flux3_klein_t2i template (Comfy-Org/workflow_templates) flattened from its subgraph, at full precision in place of the template's int8_convrot defaults (a different numeric class). Weights come from the Base repo itself: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy (gated separately; 403 for the bench account on 2026-10-16) ships flux3_image_klein_base_bf16.safetensors and flux2-vae.safetensors with the same LFS sha256 as the Base repo's model.safetensors and ae.safetensors, and its qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors is the Base repo's two text_encoder shards in one file (merge:, names and values unchanged; ComfyUI's flux3 CLIPLoader maps the transformers key prefix itself). The template's prompt-upsampler branch is left out: the case already carries the upsampled caption. Sampler euler / scheduler simple and the empty negative prompt follow the template; steps, CFG, size and seed follow the case. MultiGPU_WorkUnits (cfg_gpus 2) puts the CFG branches on the two GPUs, ComfyUI's counterpart of CFG parallelism. --gpu-only keeps every model on the card (placement only). 2xH200 2026-10-16 (flux3x-h200, ComfyUI 5a665890, torch 2.14.1+cu130): eager CFG split 5.364 s (5.321-5.527); on one GPU compiled 9.046 s against eager 9.734 s. Other hardware VALIDATION PENDING.
default.policy_exception: Compile broken with the CFG split, not a speed choice (2026-10-16, ComfyUI 5a665890 on torch 2.14.1+cu130, 2xH200): with TorchCompileModel in front of MultiGPU_WorkUnits the first KSampler fails with torch._dynamo TorchRuntimeError 'Tensor device mismatch' (cuda:1 and cuda:0) in the time embedding, so the two-GPU cell runs eager. The eager split (5.36 s) beats the best compiled layout, one GPU (9.05 s). --gpu-only is needed for compile at all: without it, ComfyUI's auto-enabled dynamic VRAM records a malloc graph inside the dynamo trace and fails on 'torch.Stream' has no attribute 'cuda_stream'.
